title: OpenAI skill metadata
description: JSON Schema for agents/openai.yaml metadata per the OpenAI skill spec (https://github.com/openai/skills/blob/main/skills/.system/skill-creator/references/openai_yaml.md).

display_name.description: Human-facing title shown in UI skill lists and chips.

short_description.description: Human-facing short UI blurb (25–64 chars) for quick scanning.

icon_small.description: Path to a small icon asset (relative to skill dir). Defaults to ./assets/.

icon_large.description: Path to a larger logo asset (relative to skill dir). Defaults to ./assets/.

brand_color.description: Hex color used for UI accents (e.g., badges).

default_prompt.description: Default prompt snippet inserted when invoking the skill. Should explicitly mention the skill as $skill-name.

type.description: Dependency category. Only 'mcp' is supported for now.

value.description: Identifier of the tool or dependency.

url.description: MCP server URL when type is 'mcp'.
